title: Contact/set: oldState hardcoded null violates RFC 8620 §5.3
description:
ChatContactSetHandler response hardcodes oldState: Value::Null. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires oldState to be the state string at the beginning of the method call. With null, clients cannot anchor a subsequent Contact/changes call to detect concurrent modifications. All other Set handlers (Chat/set, Message/set) compute oldState correctly via store.contacts().get_state().

Fix: call store.contacts().get_state() before applying changes, store it, emit in response.
